dataset.name: Nanjing Drum Tower anti-PD-1 HCC cohort (2023)
dataset.description: Independent hepatocellular-carcinoma cohort with tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall- and progression-free-survival follow-up among patients treated with anti-PD-1.
dataset.cohort_context: The source release contains RNA sequencing for 41 HCC tumors and 25 paired or unpaired nontumor liver specimens. TRACE Explorer prespecifies the 17 HCC patients marked as receiving anti-PD-1 therapy and excludes untreated tumors and nontumor tissues before endpoint analysis.
dataset.source_provider: GEO expression and PMC public article supplement

metadata.source_program: Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital hepatocellular-carcinoma multiomics cohort
metadata.source_data_system: GEO gene-expression matrix and Europe PMC article supplement
metadata.library_method: Bulk RNA sequencing of human HCC tumor and nontumor liver specimens
metadata.treatment_context: Seventeen patients with HCC and available clinical response to anti-PD-1 therapy
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined overall and progression-free survival in the anti-PD-1-treated subset
metadata.sample_selection_note: Supplementary Table S1 contains 41 unique HCC clinical labels, all present among the 66 GSE202069 expression columns. Eligibility is fixed before endpoint analysis to PD1.therapy = Yes, a present tumor expression column, positive OS and PFS times and explicit binary event indicators, retaining 17 unique patients. The other 24 clinical tumors were not treated with anti-PD-1, and the 25 nontumor expression columns have no eligible clinical record.
metadata.expression_processing_note: GEO names the supplied file as a gene TPM expression matrix, but its numeric range is already log2-like and the source does not document the exact offset. TRACE Explorer therefore preserves the released values unchanged and does not apply a second transformation or infer an offset.
metadata.expression_curation_note: The pinned GSE202069 matrix contains 31,082 non-empty exact and case-insensitively unique gene symbols across 66 columns. The 17 eligible tumor columns contain no missing or nonfinite values.
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source OS and PFS fields encode 1 as an observed event and 0 as censoring. The retained anti-PD-1 cohort contains 9 OS events and 8 OS-censored observations, and 11 PFS events and 6 PFS-censored observations. The article supplement does not state the exact clinical time origin, so TRACE Explorer preserves the endpoints as source-defined rather than inferring a treatment landmark.
metadata.overlap_note: This institutional anti-PD-1 cohort is independent of TCGA-LIHC and of the active LIRI-JP, SNUH, PLANET and other external LIHC releases.
metadata.license_note: The CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 article identifies GSE202069 as the transcriptomic source and publicly supplies individual clinical data. Files are downloaded and transformed in place with pinned hashes; redistribution of source or derived expression remains disabled.

samples.sample_role: HCC tumor specimen used for bulk RNA sequencing in an anti-PD-1-treated patient

expression.label: Source-provided log2-like TPM expression
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 31,082 supplied gene labels are non-empty and case-insensitively unique, so no aggregation or online remapping is applied.
expression.scale_note: The GSE202069 values are preserved unchanged because they are already log2-like and the source does not document the exact offset. Values are intended only for within-cohort analyses.

endpoints.label: Source-defined overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by the source OS field

endpoints.label: Source-defined progression-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Progression or death as encoded by the source PFS field
